title: Joint completion-time guarantees for online relief distribution: a network obstruction and a tight tree budget — companion code and constructed evidence
description: Exact-arithmetic companion evidence for contribution version V5. Includes unchanged general-network and tree readers, frozen constructed inputs, complete reference results, offline witnesses, algebra certificates, running instructions and checksums. Normal checks use Python 3.10+ and only the standard library. Original code is MIT licensed; original constructed inputs/results/documentation are CC BY 4.0. Replays are not new independent scientific samples, field tests, formal proofs or novelty certification. See the repository README for scope, negative results and comparison exclusions.
notes: Mixed components: MIT for original code; CC BY 4.0 for original constructed data, results and documentation. The root LICENSE_SCOPE.json maps these components. Frozen historical V4/private-candidate identifiers remain unchanged for provenance. This archive is a different work from the earlier marginal-recurrence manuscript.
